note: Guild exp tax, the guild skills Battle Orders, Regeneration, Restore and Emergency Call, and guild skill blocks at login. The header holds the battle_config values the cases use, at rAthena's defaults, except where a case says otherwise. 'skills' lists skill_db values of each guild skill level: SplashArea, Duration1, Duration2, Cooldown, CastTime and, in renewal, FixedCastTime. Guilds are made with guild_recv_info, as when the char server sends them. Guild 1 is the main guild. Guild 2 has no relation to it. Guild 3 is allied with guild 1 (alliance opposition 0). The first member of a guild is its master, at position 0. Every player is a sample Knight with the melee build. tax_cases: a guild member at position 1 receives exp through pc_gainexp(sd, nullptr, base, job, exp_flag), with job equal to base. 'rate' is position 1's exp_mode, set directly in the guild (guild_change_position would cap it at guild_exp_limit, but guild_payexp reads the stored value). The player starts at base level 50 and job level 25 with no exp. 'expboost' is SC_EXPBOOST's val1 (a Battle Manual), or 0 for none. 'tax_taken' is the sum of what guild_payexp took and put in the guild exp cache, and 'tax_calls' how many times it took something. 'added' is the base and job exp pc_gainexp added to the player after the tax, pc_calcexp and the caps, before level ups, or null when it added nothing. The '_before' and '_after' fields are the player's levels and exp around the call. Level ups use the exp, and with multi_level_up off a call gains at most one level and keeps 1 exp less than the next level, so 'added' is the amount to compare. kill_cases: a monster dies through mob_dead, as in party_share.json's exp cases, with some players in guild 1. 'players' have the party_share.json fields plus 'guild_position' (-1 for none) and 'tax_rate'. 'gained' lists every pc_gainexp call with the base and job exp passed in. 'taxed' lists every tax guild_payexp took: the base exp passed in, the tax, and the rate. 'added' lists what each pc_gainexp call added, in call order. skill_cases: the players of guild_skill_players stand around the caster on prontera (156, 191), at 'dx' and 'dy' from the caster. 'other_map' stands on izlude, so its 'dx' and 'dy' are null. 'dead' has dead_sit set and 0 HP. 'disable_call' has status.disable_call set. 'gvg' is MF_GVG on prontera, set with map_setmapflag for the case. 'emergency_call' is battle_config.emergency_call for the case. 'caster' is the index of the casting player: 0 is guild 1's master, 1 is a member who is not the master. Guild 1 has GD_APPROVAL 1, GD_GUARDRESEARCH 1, GD_EXTENSION 5, GD_BATTLEORDER 1, GD_REGENERATION at the case's level (3 when the case casts another skill), GD_RESTORE 1 and GD_EMERGENCYCALL 1. Before the cast, every living player has a quarter of its max HP and SP, and the skill blocks from guild_recv_info are removed. 'cast' has 'not_ok' (skill_isNotOk), 'castbegin' (skill_check_condition_castbegin) and 'check_fails' (clif_skill_fail calls during those two checks), then 'used' (what unit_skilluse_id returned) and 'fails' (clif_skill_fail calls during the cast). 'cause' is the useskill_fail_cause value. When the skill has a cast time, 'cast_time' is the time of its timer and skill_castend_id is called at once. 'used' is 1 when the cast started, even if it did nothing. 'blocks' are the caster's skill blocks (skill_blockpc_start) by skill ID, in milliseconds from just before the cast to the block's end. Renewal blocks the cast skill for its Cooldown. Pre-renewal blocks all four skills for the cast skill's Duration2 (guild_block_skill). The real clock runs during a case, so a time can be 1 or 2 ms more than the setting. 'second', when present, is a second cast by the same caster right after the first, with canact_tick and canskill_tick cleared, so only skill blocks stop it. 'blocks_after_second' are the blocks after it. Each player has 'hp', 'sp' and 'stats' (battle_status) before the cast, and 'hp_after', 'sp_after', 'stats_after', 'statuses', 'map_after', 'dx_after' and 'dy_after' after it. 'statuses' are the player's statuses by SC_ value and name, with val1 to val4 and 'timer', the milliseconds from the cast to the status's next timer. Emergency Call moves players with pc_setpos, so 'map_after', 'dx_after' and 'dy_after' show where it put them relative to the caster. 'dx_after' and 'dy_after' are null for a player on another map. rAthena picks the offset by the member's slot in the guild (slot modulo 9, the caster's own slot and skipped members included) from dx -1, 1, 0, 0, -1, 1, -1, 1, 0 and dy 0, 0, 1, -1, 1, -1, -1, 1, 0. relog_cases: guild 1 with its master and one member, both online. 'blocks' are the master's skill blocks after each step, in milliseconds from just before the step. 'first_guild_info_master_online' is guild_recv_info for a guild the map server did not have. 'guild_info_again' is guild_recv_info for the same guild again. 'member_joined_connect_new' and 'member_joined_not_new' are guild_member_joined for the master with state.connect_new 1 (login) and 0 (map change), after the blocks are removed and gmaster_flag is cleared. guild_gm_changed is not recorded: it blocks the new master's skills only when the player has a client connection (fd), which recorder players do not have.
